hints.title: Longest Palindromic Subsequence
hints.text: The minimum number of insertions equals the length of string s minus the length of its longest palindromic subsequence.

hints.title: Reduction to Subsequence Matching
hints.text: The longest palindromic subsequence of s equals the longest common subsequence of s and its reverse.

hints.title: Compute and Subtract
hints.text: Find longest common subsequence length between s and its reverse. Then return string length minus that common length.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing insertions recursively generates 2^N branch possibilities.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual 1D array space reduces quadratic memory to linear space while maintaining O(N^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes the mathematical duality with the longest palindromic subsequence.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved via interval DP where dp[i][j] is the answer for substring s[i..j].
